article.title: The Leadership Pendulum: How to Avoid the Extremes of Organizational Management
article.author: Guiding Threads Collective
article.content: “It’s funny to say this because I’m the leader of this organization, but the reality is I’m actually very uncomfortable being in charge.” Eve and I are in our regularly scheduled monthly coaching calls. Eve is a white woman in her mid-40s, a mother of three, and has been the Executive Director of a legal non-profit for the last 4 years.* She goes on to explain that having and wielding power… Source
